blocks.heading: Who is the SSV?
blocks.body:
The **student self-government (SSV)** is the elected body representing all residents of the Potsdamer Straße residence. We are students ourselves, we live here and we volunteer.

We speak for you towards the residence management, look after the common rooms and make sure neighbours become a community.
blocks.imageAlt: Placeholder image – group photo of the SSV

blocks.heading: Four things that matter to us

cards.title: Representing interests
cards.text: We bring your concerns to the residence management – from repairs to house rules.

cards.title: Building community
cards.text: We create places and occasions for residents to get to know each other.

cards.title: Organising events
cards.text: Semester start, game nights, summer party: we plan all year round.

cards.title: Shaping the residence
cards.text: Common rooms, garden, workshop – we develop the house together.

blocks.heading: New to the residence?
blocks.text: Here you will find the most important information about the SSV, events and ways to meet other residents.

blocks.heading: Join us!
blocks.text: The SSV thrives on the ideas and commitment of the residents. Whether you help out once or join a working group – every contribution counts.
